stem: A Massachusetts nuclear pharmacy is describing its services to a hospital client. Which activities fall inside the regulatory definition of radiopharmaceutical service? Select all that apply.

choices.text: Counting, dispensing, labeling and delivery of radiopharmaceuticals.
Operating the imaging equipment on which the product is later used.
Interpreting the images produced after the product is administered.
Prescribing the radiopharmaceutical for the individual hospital patient.
Advising on therapeutic values, hazards and use of radiopharmaceuticals.

explanation.core_reasoning: 247 CMR 13.02 defines radiopharmaceutical service as counting, dispensing, labeling and delivery; participating in radiopharmaceutical selection and utilization reviews; proper and safe storage and distribution; maintaining radiopharmaceutical quality assurance; advising on therapeutic values, hazards and use; and the acts necessary to conduct such services within a nuclear pharmacy. Imaging operation, image interpretation and prescribing are outside it.

choice_analysis.A: Correct: the four handling verbs open the definition.
choice_analysis.B: Equipment operation is not within the defined service.
choice_analysis.C: Image interpretation is not within the defined service.
choice_analysis.D: Prescribing is not within the defined service.
choice_analysis.E: Correct: the advisory limb is expressly included.

related_facts: Radiopharmaceutical quality assurance includes authentication of product history
explanation.mpje_trap: Candidates treat everything a nuclear pharmacy touches clinically as part of the defined service.

reasoning_steps: Read the definition to its end rather than stopping at the handling verbs
Test each described activity against the listed limbs
Exclude activities the definition does not name
